message.content:
A magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "20-26 MARET 2017" features an editorial illustration on a light cream grid background. The bold red masthead "TEMPO" is at the top, with "INVESTIGASI: CUKONG TKI DI MALAYSIA" above it and "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below.

The central illustration depicts a stylized landscape of jagged, brown, earth-toned mountains shown in profile. The mountains create a sharp divide across the page. At the top of these peaks, two men in suits walk upward. One wears a dark grey suit, and the other wears a blue suit while carrying a red briefcase.

Below the mountain line, several figures are positioned in a lighter-toned lower section. A man in a yellow shirt stands in a red boat on a mirrored water surface, holding an oar. On the right, four smaller figures stand on a downward-sloping line: one in a construction vest and helmet, one in a blue uniform, one carrying a tool over his shoulder, and one with a large backpack. Another figure with a backpack walks alone in the center.

Large white text reads "KAYA RAYA, MISKIN PAPA." Smaller text describes economic inequality and the Gini index under Jokowi's third year of government. A barcode and price of "RP 45.000" are at the bottom left.
